snippet.title: Nadirim: Lore trailer (improved)
snippet.description: Nadirim is a free-to-play online fantasy role playing game (MMORPG). Explore the world of Arabian fable and myth to defeat an ancient evil. Nadirim takes browser gaming to an entirely new level with beautiful graphics, an original soundtrack and a unique setting.
